conventions.money: Decimal strings with two fractional digits, never JS-authoritative prices
conventions.dates: ISO 8601 UTC for timestamps; restaurant local date for availability
conventions.auth: Bearer access_token; revocable server sessions; restaurant context derived from authenticated membership
conventions.errors: {detail:string,code?:string}; validation errors may use FastAPI detail arrays
conventions.payments: Cash only. Public checkout never marks payment paid. Owner records cash receipt explicitly.
conventions.images: Bundled /food/*.jpg URLs; uploaded /media/* paths resolved against API origin
conventions.scope: Release 1 plus owner-operated basic order board, not the Release 2 staff/KDS/POS suite
conventions.public_visibility: Only active, published restaurants with is_demo=false are publicly listed or available for new guest activity. Fictional tenants also return 404 for direct lookup, tracking and checkout replays; their records remain privately manageable.

WebsiteSettings.gallery: [{image_url:HTTPS|/food/|/media/ URL max2000,alt:string min1 max200}]; default []; max30
WebsiteSettings.faqs: [{question:string min1 max200,answer:string min1 max3000}]; default []; max30
WebsiteSettings.homepage_sections: unique array of featured|about|gallery|hours; default [featured,about,hours]; max4; [] allowed

endpoints: {customer_name:string min1 max150,email:EmailStr max254,subject:single-line string min1 max160 (no embedded CR/LF),message:string min10 max5000,consent:true}; strings trimmed; published active tenant only

Editable Restaurant fields; website_settings:WebsiteSettings is full replacement with defaults, never null; is_demo is read-only; published validates setup and rejects private development tenants with 422; their other private edits remain supported
Editable MenuItem fields; variant/modifier IDs optional on create

Optional fulfilment pickup|delivery and payment_status paid|unpaid; inclusive Karachi calendar dates implemented [from_date midnight, day-after-to_date midnight); from<=to; active_only excludes COMPLETED/REJECTED/CANCELLED
safety: New registrations require email verification; absent mail credentials must be explicitly surfaced, not pretend sent.
Public orders require current signed quote; price/availability changes force re-quote and explicit reconfirmation.
Order creation is transactional and idempotent, including changed payload rejection for reused keys.

Restaurant responses include website_settings:WebsiteSettings fully defaulted and is_demo:boolean read-only. Gallery/FAQ navigation requires its enabled flag and nonempty content. Text content is never raw HTML.

Reservations allocate a suitable table with transaction-safe overlap and buffer checks; REQUESTED also holds capacity. Disabled website_settings.reservations_enabled rejects availability and new bookings with 409 service_disabled, preserving existing holds and owner status changes.

Incoming orders/reservations and inquiries enqueue owner email when restaurant email exists. Customer order/reservation status and explicit cash receipt enqueue transactionally only when customer email exists. No private tracking tokens or internal reasons appear in owner/status notices. Unconfigured SMTP never means sent; generic outbox worker supports all kinds.
Suspended/unpublished restaurants are not public and cannot accept orders/reservations.

Existing real-restaurant tracking and matching idempotent checkout retries remain available after unpublication; the is_demo exclusion is applied before replay. Platform published_restaurants excludes private development tenants.
Cash payment recording must be explicit, auditable and duplicate-safe.
Status colors are semantic; one ZAYQORA logo, typography, navy/teal theme shared across every interface.

Fictional seeded restaurants retain their read-only is_demo marker and are not public. Controlled test screenshots must be identified as test data; never relabel fictional records as real businesses or claim payment, email, GPS, certifications or production readiness that are not configured.
